title: 球面支承安裝
subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design
summary: 從支承配置與熱位移出發，量化球面支承的轉角需求、滑動材料承壓、曲面摩擦力矩與偏心，再處理工廠預設偏移、墊層灌漿、運輸固定件拆除、型式試驗、現場位移指標與累積滑移磨耗，最後以萊茵河上兩座斜張橋的 120 MN 級球面支承更換與新建案例，說明頂升更換與交接紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from bearing layout and thermal movement, quantify a spherical bearing's rotation demand, sliding-material pressure, curved-surface friction moment and eccentricity, then handle factory presetting, bedding grout, removal of transport fittings, type testing, movement indicators and accumulated sliding wear, closing with jacking replacement and handover records through 120 MN class spherical bearings on two Rhine cable-stayed bridges.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

architectureNodes: Upper sliding plate and stainless sheet

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「約束配置與熱位移」與「豎向反力與轉角需求」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Restraint layout and thermal movement" and "Vertical reaction and rotation demand": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fixed, guided and free layout” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。溫度、混凝土潛變乾縮與預力縮短讓梁以固定點為原點伸縮，距固定點越遠的支承滑移量越大；球面支承把轉動交給球冠曲面、把滑動交給上方平面滑板，兩種自由度各自由不同滑動面負責。配置錯誤時，熱位移被束制，水平力直接打進橋墩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point; the other bearings are guided (sliding only longitudinally) or free (sliding in all horizontal directions), and transverse restraint is concentrated in a few guided bearings. Temperature, concrete creep and shrinkage and prestress shortening make the deck expand and contract about the fixed point, so bearings farther from it slide more. A spherical bearing assigns rotation to its curved calotte and sliding to the flat plate above it, so each freedom has its own sliding surface. With a wrong layout, thermal movement is restrained and horizontal force is driven straight into the piers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fixed, guided and free layout” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fixed, guided and free layout”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 約束配置與熱位移
knowledge.text: 一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。溫度、混凝土潛變乾縮與預力縮短讓梁以固定點為原點伸縮，距固定點越遠的支承滑移量越大；球面支承把轉動交給球冠曲面、把滑動交給上方平面滑板，兩種自由度各自由不同滑動面負責。
knowledge.textEn: A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point; the other bearings are guided (sliding only longitudinally) or free (sliding in all horizontal directions), and transverse restraint is concentrated in a few guided bearings. Temperature, concrete creep and shrinkage and prestress shortening make the deck expand and contract about the fixed point, so bearings farther from it slide more.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「約束配置與熱位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Restraint layout and thermal movement" is correct?
options: 固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。
一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。
球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。
optionsEn: The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is.
A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point.
A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated.
quiz.explanation: 一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point; the other bearings are guided (sliding only longitudinally) or free (sliding in all horizontal directions), and transverse restraint is concentrated in a few guided bearings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fixed, guided and free layout” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼—混凝土複合梁 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、支承距固定點 L = 240 m、有效溫差 ΔT = 60°C，ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm，約為平均位置 ±86 mm；若把固定點從聯中央移到端部，L 變為 480 m，滑移量加倍到約 346 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a steel–concrete composite girder with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C, a bearing L = 240 m from the fixed point and an effective range ΔT = 60°C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm, about ±86 mm from the mean position; moving the fixed point from mid-unit to the end makes L = 480 m and doubles the travel to about 346 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致；再以結構模型輸出各支承的位移包絡，核對滑板長度是否涵蓋位移加安全餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼—混凝土複合梁 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、支承距固定點 L = 240 m、有效溫差 ΔT = 60°C，ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm，約為平均位置 ±86 mm；若把固定點從聯中央移到端部，L 變為 480 m，滑移量加倍到約 346 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a steel–concrete composite girder with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C, a bearing L = 240 m from the fixed point and an effective range ΔT = 60°C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm, about ±86 mm from the mean position; moving the fixed point from mid-unit to the end makes L = 480 m and doubles the travel to about 346 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「約束配置與熱位移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Restraint layout and thermal movement", which statement holds?
options: 球面支承完全不傳遞彎矩，可以當成理想鉸接點。
調整高程用的鋼墊片可以留著當作永久的傳力路徑。
熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
optionsEn: A spherical bearing transmits no moment at all and can be treated as an ideal pin.
Steel shims used for levelling can stay as the permanent load path.
Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
quiz.explanation: 熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fixed, guided and free layout” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致；再以結構模型輸出各支承的位移包絡，核對滑板長度是否涵蓋位移加安全餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支承一覽表要附箭頭示意圖標出每個支承的可動方向與固定點，曲線橋與斜橋的導向方向須以指向固定點的弦線決定，並由設計者在施工圖上簽認後才進行製造。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The bearing schedule must include an arrow diagram showing each bearing's free directions and the fixed point; for curved and skewed bridges the guide direction follows the chord toward the fixed point, and the designer signs it off on the construction drawings before fabrication.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致；再以結構模型輸出各支承的位移包絡，核對滑板長度是否涵蓋位移加安全餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 支承一覽表要附箭頭示意圖標出每個支承的可動方向與固定點，曲線橋與斜橋的導向方向須以指向固定點的弦線決定，並由設計者在施工圖上簽認後才進行製造。
knowledge.textEn: The bearing schedule must include an arrow diagram showing each bearing's free directions and the fixed point; for curved and skewed bridges the guide direction follows the chord toward the fixed point, and the designer signs it off on the construction drawings before fabrication.

quiz.question: 要驗證「約束配置與熱位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Restraint layout and thermal movement"?
options: 把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
位移指針還在刻度範圍內，就代表支承功能正常。
optionsEn: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the movement pointer is still within the scale, the bearing is working properly.
quiz.explanation: 把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致；再以結構模型輸出各支承的位移包絡，核對滑板長度是否涵蓋位移加安全餘裕。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fixed, guided and free layout” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：配置錯誤時，熱位移被束制，水平力直接打進橋墩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With a wrong layout, thermal movement is restrained and horizontal force is driven straight into the piers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。
knowledge.textEn: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「約束配置與熱位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restraint layout and thermal movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。
球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops.
A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated.
quiz.explanation: 同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「設計轉角 θ」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design rotation θ” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動；球面支承讓上方的凸面球冠在下方凹面座內滑動，因此可以同時容納任意方向的轉角，而且轉動時接觸面壓力分布幾乎不變，這是它相對於盆式或橡膠支承的主要優勢。設計轉角必須把結構計算值加上製造與安裝允差，因為支承座板很難做到完全水平。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「設計轉角 θ」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis. In a spherical bearing the convex calotte slides inside a concave seat, so it accommodates rotation in any direction while the contact pressure distribution stays almost unchanged, its main advantage over pot or elastomeric bearings. The design rotation must add fabrication and installation tolerances to the structural value, because bearing plates are never set perfectly level. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Design rotation θ” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「設計轉角 θ」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Design rotation θ”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求
knowledge.text: 梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動；球面支承讓上方的凸面球冠在下方凹面座內滑動，因此可以同時容納任意方向的轉角，而且轉動時接觸面壓力分布幾乎不變，這是它相對於盆式或橡膠支承的主要優勢。設計轉角必須把結構計算值加上製造與安裝允差，因為支承座板很難做到完全水平。
knowledge.textEn: Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis. In a spherical bearing the convex calotte slides inside a concave seat, so it accommodates rotation in any direction while the contact pressure distribution stays almost unchanged, its main advantage over pot or elastomeric bearings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「豎向反力與轉角需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vertical reaction and rotation demand" is correct?
options: 球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。
PTFE 不會磨損，所以滑動支承裝好之後就是免維護的。
梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動。
optionsEn: A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated.
PTFE does not wear, so a sliding bearing is maintenance-free once installed.
Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis.
quiz.explanation: 梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動；球面支承讓上方的凸面球冠在下方凹面座內滑動，因此可以同時容納任意方向的轉角，而且轉動時接觸面壓力分布幾乎不變，這是它相對於盆式或橡膠支承的主要優勢。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計轉角 θ」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Design rotation θ” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。取 w = 120 kN/m、L = 60 m、E = 34 GPa、I = 12 m⁴，EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m²，θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad；加計 0.005 rad 安裝允差後約 0.0076 rad，規格取 0.01 rad。數值為教學假設，允差依適用規範核定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI). With w = 120 kN/m, L = 60 m, E = 34 GPa and I = 12 m⁴, EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m² and θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad; adding a 0.005 rad installation allowance gives about 0.0076 rad, specified as 0.01 rad. Values are teaching assumptions; tolerances follow the governing code. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。取 w = 120 kN/m、L = 60 m、E = 34 GPa、I = 12 m⁴，EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m²，θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad；加計 0.005 rad 安裝允差後約 0.0076 rad，規格取 0.01 rad。數值為教學假設，允差依適用規範核定。
knowledge.textEn: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI). With w = 120 kN/m, L = 60 m, E = 34 GPa and I = 12 m⁴, EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m² and θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad; adding a 0.005 rad installation allowance gives about 0.0076 rad, specified as 0.01 rad. Values are teaching assumptions; tolerances follow the governing code.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「豎向反力與轉角需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vertical reaction and rotation demand", which statement holds?
options: 簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。
安裝當天的氣溫就等於梁體溫度，可以直接拿來設定預設量。
支承只要額定荷重夠大，任何轉角與溫度下都一定合格。
optionsEn: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI).
The air temperature on installation day equals the girder temperature and can be used directly to set the preset.
If a bearing's rated load is high enough, it passes at any rotation and temperature.
quiz.explanation: 簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計轉角 θ」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Design rotation θ” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支承規格書要分列結構轉角、允差與總設計轉角，並註明繞哪兩個軸；製造商圖面須標示金屬接觸前的最大轉角與剩餘間隙，作為現場檢查的比對值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The bearing specification lists structural rotation, tolerance and total design rotation separately and names both axes; the manufacturer's drawing must show the maximum rotation before metal contact and the remaining clearance as a reference for site inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若轉角需求低估，球冠滑到凹面邊緣後上座板與下座板金屬接觸（硬點），反力集中在邊緣，可能壓壞滑動材料、使座板翹曲並在梁底或墩帽造成局部壓碎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If rotation demand is underestimated, the calotte runs to the edge of the concave seat and the upper and lower plates touch metal to metal, concentrating the reaction at the edge, which can crush the sliding material, warp the plates and locally crush the girder soffit or pier cap. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 支承規格書要分列結構轉角、允差與總設計轉角，並註明繞哪兩個軸；製造商圖面須標示金屬接觸前的最大轉角與剩餘間隙，作為現場檢查的比對值。
knowledge.textEn: The bearing specification lists structural rotation, tolerance and total design rotation separately and names both axes; the manufacturer's drawing must show the maximum rotation before metal contact and the remaining clearance as a reference for site inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「豎向反力與轉角需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vertical reaction and rotation demand"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較。
支承的磨耗只取決於季節溫差造成的大位移。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation.
Bearing wear depends only on the large seasonal thermal movements.
quiz.explanation: 以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設計轉角 θ」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Design rotation θ” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若轉角需求低估，球冠滑到凹面邊緣後上座板與下座板金屬接觸（硬點），反力集中在邊緣，可能壓壞滑動材料、使座板翹曲並在梁底或墩帽造成局部壓碎。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If rotation demand is underestimated, the calotte runs to the edge of the concave seat and the upper and lower plates touch metal to metal, concentrating the reaction at the edge, which can crush the sliding material, warp the plates and locally crush the girder soffit or pier cap. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計轉角必須把結構計算值加上製造與安裝允差，因為支承座板很難做到完全水平。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design rotation must add fabrication and installation tolerances to the structural value, because bearing plates are never set perfectly level.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若轉角需求低估，球冠滑到凹面邊緣後上座板與下座板金屬接觸（硬點），反力集中在邊緣，可能壓壞滑動材料、使座板翹曲並在梁底或墩帽造成局部壓碎。
knowledge.textEn: If rotation demand is underestimated, the calotte runs to the edge of the concave seat and the upper and lower plates touch metal to metal, concentrating the reaction at the edge, which can crush the sliding material, warp the plates and locally crush the girder soffit or pier cap.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「豎向反力與轉角需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vertical reaction and rotation demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
PTFE 不會磨損，所以滑動支承裝好之後就是免維護的。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
PTFE does not wear, so a sliding bearing is maintenance-free once installed.
